title: Media segments and intro skip
description: Serves "Finding something to watch is easy.". From operator data or chapter markers; no fingerprinting.
acceptanceCriteria: Before anything is built, the share of the dogfood's episodes and films with a chapter marker named for an intro or credits is counted (shares only, no titles) and brought to the product owner in a brief: how many viewers' episodes get a skip button from chapters and operator data alone
Where a film or episode has an intro or credits marked (chapter names or the operator's data), Octave can offer a skip at the right moment.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
notes: Requested by Fluster, the client that ships with jellyscale: #103. No fingerprinting or other detection (D-036); the count decides whether that is reopened.
